_comment: Template for appsettings.Production.json. Copy to appsettings.Production.json on the server (gitignored) and fill in real values. Do NOT commit real secrets.
_DataProtectionComment: MUST be outside the deploy root. deploy.bat moves the application directory wholesale on every release; a key ring inside it is lost, and every stored mailbox client secret becomes undecryptable and has to be re-entered. The app pool identity needs read/write here.
_LocalStorageComment: Also MUST be outside the deploy root, for the same reason: this is where report PDFs and generated summary files live. Leaving it unset puts them under the app directory, where the next deploy moves them into the backup folder.
_MailboxIngestComment: Background pickup of patrol report emails. Per-property credentials, mailbox, filters and cadence are configured in the app under Settings > Automated Report Pickup; these settings only control the polling loop itself. Set Enabled to false to stop all automatic polling (the manual 'Check now' button still works).
